_comment: CANONICAL MODEL RATE CARD — source of truth for the 'ai-model-rates' KVM, key 'rate_card'.
Rates are USD per 1,000,000 tokens (Vertex AI PAYG list price).
1. Every key here MUST be a model that exists in this project. Verify with
before adding one. Three non-existent Claude IDs previously sat in this KVM.
2. Every entitled model MUST appear here. A model that is granted in an API product
but missing from this card is silently billed at the 'default' rate.
3. 'tier' is a COST band, not an entitlement. Bands by output rate:
4. Do NOT infer tier from the model name. gemini-3.7-flash and gemini-3.8-flash are
